text:
michael: Heads up — release cutover is blocked, CI failing on staging. Looks like cache TTL regenerated during artifact fetch and deploy-bot put a hold. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: pipeline failed on step 'restore-cache' (exit 1).

sarah: Can you paste the failing logs?

ci-runner: ```
Step: restore-cache
Error: checksum mismatch extracting layer
expected: abc123def456
actual:   def456abc789
at github.com/redwood/cache.(*Extractor).Extract
    /workspace/cache/extractor.go:142
Exit code: 1
```

jamie: This smells like a cache key regen race after TTL expiry — two processes uploaded different manifests for the same logical key. One got promoted, the other got an alternate digest.

michael: We were mid-cutover at 10:15 UTC. Can we rollback to previous image and pin the canary tag to avoid re-promoting bad artifact?

lisa: I can pin the canary to redwood/canary:2026-03-20-rc1 and re-trigger the promotion. We're still inside the change window (10:00-11:00 UTC). Need a quick thumbs up to proceed.

oncall-devops: change window acknowledged. If we pin and force promote, I'll monitor infra and be ready to revert routes. What's the rollback plan?

jamie: Rollback plan: revert traffic to tag 'canary-stable-20260319' and redeploy with that image. DB migrations were designed to be backwards compatible for this cutover, so revert should be safe. I'll open a bug for the cache service: add atomic upload + content-addressed indexing to avoid TTL regen races.

michael: OK lisa, please pin and trigger.

lisa: Pinned tag to redwood/canary:2026-03-20-rc1 and updated deploy config. Re-running deploybot now:
`/deploy promote canary --force`

deploy-bot: Manual promotion request received from lisa. Starting validation: artifact verification, smoke tests, route dry-run.

ci-runner: Note — restore-cache still intermittently fails. Temporary workaround: set CI_CACHE_RESTORE=false for the build to skip cache restore. Builds will be ~6m slower but deterministic.

sarah: Skipping cache restore is fine for canary promotion to unblock. We'll accept the slower build.

michael: Do it. jamie, please prioritize the cache-service hotfix; we should avoid manual pins frequently.

jamie: On it. Creating ticket RW-1423: "cache: atomic upload + stable key generation to prevent TTL regen digest drift". Will aim for a patch today.

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded — canary route updated and 10% traffic shifted. Notifying #product and #sre. :tada:

ci-runner: Artifact digest recorded: abc123def456 stored at 2026-03-20T10:23:45Z.

lisa: Closing loop here. Monitor for any anomaly for the next 2 hours. michael, jamie — please post a short postmortem in RW-1423 when you have the fix.

michael: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sarah: Leaving a note for release notes: "Hotfix: temporary pin used to work around cache regeneration causing checksum mismatch; follow-up fix in RW-1423."

lisa: Thread closed unless new errors appear.
